entities.summary: Jenny Beavan is a British costume designer. She has received numerous accolades, including three Academy Awards, four BAFTA Film Awards, two Emmy Awards, and an Olivier Award, in addition to nominations for three BAFTA Television Awards and a Tony Award. She was honored with the Costume Designers Guild Career Achievement Award in 2025. Beavan was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in 2017.
